project.name: qsot2-math-verification
project.canonical_statement: Reference run and claim-governance record for QSOT2, the re-scoped mathematical-consistency verifier of the QSOT program and the honest math-line successor of the v1.2.3 slop artifact (toe-test-0057): a bounded, claim-labeled phenomenological verifier, verified for model-output consistency only. Math line of the 3-line split; sibling of toe-test-0059 (QSOT-Harness combined).

design_invariants.label: lean-machine-readable-claim-boundary
design_invariants.statement: Every result must serialize the lean 4-field claim boundary (external_physical_validation_provided=false, first_principles_derivation_provided=false, mathematical_consistency_scope_only=true, phenomenological_model=true) under schema qsot2.math_consistency.experiment_result.v1.

binding.origin_episode: EXP-058: 3-line split; QSOT2 carries the math core with a lean schema, governance moved out.

design_invariants.label: advisory-metric-positioning
design_invariants.statement: All computed values are strictly advisory heuristics under a phenomenological channel-map ansatz. Gate and verdict labels are policy-derived classifications, not physical observables. No external physical claims or quantum-gravity derivations are made.

binding.origin_episode: EXP-058: honest math-line successor of the v1.2.3 slop artifact; provenance locked to ADVISORY.

design_invariants.label: negative-results-surfaced
design_invariants.statement: Non-failure degradations must be surfaced, not hidden: KD optimizer non-convergence -> DEGRADED_PASS; the model trajectory is Markovian by construction (nm=0).

binding.origin_episode: EXP-058: DEGRADED_PASS verdict reported in the result artifact with its documented cause.

design_invariants.label: model-package-governance-import-boundary
design_invariants.statement: The model package (src/qsot2/model/) must not import governance. Governance (phase6) is moved to experimental/ and excluded from the verdict path; reusable governance primitives live in flamehaven-sci-governance.

binding.origin_episode: EXP-058: clean migration from QSOT V2 with separated git history; phase6 demoted to experimental, governance extracted.

operation_meta.bootstrap_note: MICA package created for toe-test-0058 as the QSOT2 math-verification line of the 3-line QSOT split; supersedes toe-test-0057; sibling of toe-test-0059. Source 9e1d845, lean schema, artifact hash efca2228.
